pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which day comes right before Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Donnerstag
   C. Montag
   D. Freitag

2. What does "von März bis Mai" mean? (1 mark)
   A. from May to March
   B. from March to May
   C. after May
   D. in March only

3. What should you do first when reading a text for comprehension? (1 mark)
   A. Read only the last line
   B. Guess the answers
   C. Copy the whole text
   D. Look at the title and pictures

4. Which month is "Dezember"? (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. October
   C. December
   D. September

5. What does "sehen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. to see
   B. to hear
   C. to speak
   D. to eat

6. Which German word or phrase means "cooker"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tisch
   B. der Herd
   C. die Dusche
   D. die Küche

7. What does "die Tochter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. father
   C. daughter
   D. sister

8. Which little word goes with the noun "Wochenende"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. der
   C. das
   D. den

9. What does "gern" mean? (1 mark)
   A. often
   B. gladly
   C. because
   D. never

10. What does "das Sofa" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. garden
   C. plate
   D. fridge

11. What does "Januar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. March
   B. May
   C. January
   D. April

12. What does "das Lied" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. birthday
   B. candle
   C. song
   D. cake

13. Which German word or phrase means "very good"? (1 mark)
   A. Bis bald
   B. Sehr gut
   C. Guten Abend
   D. Entschuldigung

14. Which German word or phrase means "good night"? (1 mark)
   A. Hallo
   B. Ja
   C. Gute Nacht
   D. Sehr gut

15. When do you say "Gute Nacht"? (1 mark)
   A. When you meet a teacher
   B. When you say hello at midday
   C. When someone goes to bed
   D. When you meet in the morning

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato. (2 marks)

17. Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German. (2 marks)

18. Explain why a menu uses a colon after the meal name. (2 marks)

19. Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday. (4 marks)

20. Write three sentences about your body in German. (3 marks)

21. Name two ways to make the kitchen safer at home. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Freitag
   Before Samstag comes Freitag.

2. B — from March to May
   von ... bis means from ... to.

3. D — Look at the title and pictures
   The title and pictures give clues about the topic.

4. C — December
   Dezember is the last month of the year.

5. A — to see
   We see with our eyes.

6. B — der Herd
   cooker in German is der Herd.

7. C — daughter
   die Tochter means daughter.

8. C — das
   It is das Wochenende, so the little word is das.

9. B — gladly
   gern means with pleasure, gladly.

10. A — sofa
   das Sofa means sofa.

11. C — January
   Januar means January.

12. C — song
   das Lied means song.

13. B — Sehr gut
   very good in German is Sehr gut.

14. C — Gute Nacht
   good night in German is Gute Nacht.

15. C — When someone goes to bed
   Gute Nacht wishes someone a good night as they go to sleep.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces the list of food that follows.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for announces the list and 1 mark for an example.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep hot pots and matches away from small children; never leave the cooker alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
